generation.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one original Heroes of Might and Magic III hero portrait master, to be reduced to 58x64 and a face crop 48x32 pixels. Subject: Akali from League of Legends, recognizable Ionian young adult woman assassin, high black ponytail with teal streak, green cloth mask covering nose and mouth, brown eyes, bare shoulder with dark dragon tattoo and worn green ninja scarf, one small steel kunai at shoulder. Background richly mottled russet and muted vermilion. Close compact head-and-shoulders portrait, entire hair/hat silhouette within frame, face large and readable, three-quarter view. Painterly late-1990s fantasy game portrait, textured hand-painted oil miniature, natural anatomy and individual facial planes, strong warm light from upper left, crisp readable eyes and silhouette, restrained metallic highlights. Original composition, not a copy of a splash painting. No anime, no chibi, no glossy modern key art, no photoreal photograph, no typography, no border, no watermark. One character only, square composition.
